prompt:
HackMatch — College Hackathon Team Finder. MOBILE screen, 390px logical width (design at 2x), tall vertical scroll. Apply the 'Tactile Editorial Minimalist' design system: warm off-white canvas #F9F9F8, white bento cards, 1px hairline borders #E4E4E0, ink #141413, muted ink #686763, International Orange #FF4F00 for primary CTAs and live states, Electric Cobalt #2563EB for links and verified badges. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for ALL labels, IDs, counts and countdowns. Signature motifs: hairline-divided bento cells, mono caps labels, and dashed 'open slot' cells for empty capacity. Borders over shadows. No gradients, no glassmorphism.

SCREEN: Hackathon detail page.
Top bar: a back chevron, the title 'CalHacks 2025', then a bookmark icon and a share icon.
HERO bento card: a square hairline logo placeholder cell, the event name 'CalHacks 2025' very large and bold, the organizer line 'UC Berkeley · 3 partners' with a small blue verified check, and a mono line 'BERKELEY, CA · NOV 14-16'.
Below that, a 2x2 grid of hairline-divided stat cells, each with a tiny mono caps label above a bold value: MODE 'In-person', PRIZE '$40,000', TEAM SIZE '3-5', and a LIVE cell showing an orange JetBrains Mono countdown '06D 14H 22M 09S' labelled 'REG. CLOSES IN'.
Then a full-width solid orange 'Find a Team' button, and beneath it a row of two bordered buttons: 'Bookmark' with a bookmark icon and 'Share' with a share icon.
Tab row in mono caps with an orange underline on the active tab: 'ABOUT', 'TEAMS (03)', 'SCHEDULE'.
Body: 'About this hackathon' dense paragraph; then 'Tracks' as a wrapping row of mono outlined pills: AI, FINTECH, HEALTH, WEB3, CLIMATE; then 'Judging criteria' as a hairline list of 4 rows each with a mono percentage right-aligned; then 'Schedule' as a vertical timeline with mono dates on the left and hairline connectors — Registration opens, Registration closes, Opening ceremony, Submissions due, Demo day.
Section 'Recruiting Teams' with a mono caps header and a small count '03'; three team rows separated by hairlines, each row = team name in semibold, a wrapping line of mono pill tags for open roles (ML, DESIGN), the text '2 slots open', and an orange 'Request to join' link.
Section 'Solo Builders' with two compact rows: a small circular avatar, the name, mono skill pills, and a bordered 'Invite' mini button.
Finish the page with a dashed open-slot cell reading '+ Post your own need' in mono.
At the bottom, a fixed bottom tab bar with 5 entries separated by a hairline top border: Discover, Talent, Squads, Chats, Profile — icon over mono caps label, the active one in orange.

HackMatch — College Hackathon Team Finder. MOBILE screen, 390px logical width (design at 2x), tall vertical scroll. Apply the 'Tactile Editorial Minimalist' design system: warm off-white canvas #F9F9F8, white bento cards, 1px hairline borders #E4E4E0, ink #141413, muted ink #686763, International Orange #FF4F00 for primary CTAs, Electric Cobalt #2563EB for links. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for ALL labels, percentages, dates and IDs. Signature motifs: hairline-divided bento cells, mono caps labels, dashed 'open slot' cells. Borders over shadows. No gradients.

SCREEN: 'Post a Hackathon' organizer form.
Top bar: a back chevron, the title 'Post a Hackathon', and a small mono badge 'ORGANIZER'.
Progress rail in mono caps: '01 BASICS', '02 LOGISTICS', '03 TEAMS' with the first highlighted in orange, separated by em dashes.
Form card 'BASICS': stacked hairline inputs — 'Hackathon name', 'Tagline', 'Event URL'; then a dashed upload cell with mono text 'DROP LOGO HERE OR BROWSE' and a second muted mono line 'PNG/SVG · 1024×1024'.
Card 'FORMAT': a segmented control with three equal hairline options — 'IN-PERSON', 'ONLINE', 'HYBRID' — the first one selected with an orange top border and ink text.
Card 'LOGISTICS': a labelled hairline date field 'Registration closes' shown in JetBrains Mono as '2026-11-02 23:59', then a 2-column row of labelled hairline date fields 'Start' and 'End' shown in mono as '2026-11-14' and '2026-11-16', then a labelled hairline prize field 'Total prize pool' shown in mono as '$40,000'.
Card 'TEAMS': a wrapping row of mono outlined pills for 'TAGS' — AI, ML, WEB3 — each with a small x, followed by a dashed open cell '+ ADD TAG'; then a 2-column row of labelled numeric hairline inputs 'MIN TEAM SIZE' = '3' and 'MAX TEAM SIZE' = '5' both in JetBrains Mono.
Finish the page with a dashed open-slot cell reading '// draft saves automatically' in mono.
Sticky bottom action bar with a hairline top border: a bordered 'Save draft' button on the left and a wider solid orange 'Publish hackathon' button on the right.

HackMatch — College Hackathon Team Finder. MOBILE specimen sheet, 390px logical width (design at 2x), one tall page containing two clearly separated frames. Apply the 'Tactile Editorial Minimalist' design system: warm off-white canvas #F9F9F8, white bento cards, 1px hairline borders #E4E4E0, ink #141413, muted ink #686763, International Orange #FF4F00, Electric Cobalt #2563EB. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for ALL labels and numbers. Signature motif: dashed 'open slot' cells. Borders over shadows. No gradients, no glassmorphism.

FRAME A — a wide mono caps header reading 'FIG. A — LOADING' with a smaller muted mono subtitle 'skeleton cards' to its right. Below the header: a hairline filter bar containing three bordered mono chips 'DATE', 'MODE', 'PRIZE' plus a small mono badge '2 ACTIVE'; then a vertical stack of 3 identical hackathon skeleton cards. Each skeleton card is a white card with a hairline border and no shadow, mirroring the real card structure: a grey rounded square (logo slot) on the left, a wide soft-grey bar (title slot) and two shorter grey bars (meta slots) to its right, a full-width hairline divider, then a row with a small grey pill on the left and a grey rounded rectangle (button slot) on the right. Use soft neutral grey shimmer blocks.

FRAME B — a wide mono caps header reading 'FIG. B — EMPTY' with a muted mono subtitle 'no results'. Below: a single tall white card with generous padding, a thin hairline-line illustration (outline only, not filled) of a calendar with a diagonal slash, then a centered mono caps caption 'NO HACKATHONS MATCH THESE FILTERS', a smaller muted sentence 'Try widening the date range or removing a filter.', and a row of two buttons centered: a bordered 'Clear filters' and a solid orange 'Notify me'.

Both frames must look like the same product.

HackMatch — College Hackathon Team Finder. MOBILE screen, 390px logical width (design at 2x), long vertical marketing page. Apply the 'Tactile Editorial Minimalist' design system: warm off-white canvas #F9F9F8, white bento cards, 1px hairline borders #E4E4E0, ink #141413, muted ink #686763, International Orange #FF4F00 primary CTAs, Electric Cobalt #2563EB links. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for ALL labels, numbers and footer text. Signature motif: dashed 'open slot' cells. Borders over shadows. Editorial. No gradients, no glassmorphism.

SCREEN: HackMatch landing page.
Sticky top bar: a small orange rocket glyph plus the 'HackMatch' wordmark on the left, then a bordered 'Sign in' button and a solid orange 'Get started' button on the right, with a hairline bottom border.
HERO: a mono caps eyebrow 'FOR COLLEGE HACKERS'; an oversized three-line headline 'Find your hackathon. Build your squad. Win together.'; a muted supporting paragraph; then a full-width solid orange 'Get started free' button above a full-width bordered 'Browse hackathons' button; and a centered mono trust line '12,480 VERIFIED STUDENTS · 340 CAMPUSES'.
Below the hero: a realistic product bento card mock of a hackathon listing — hairline border, small logo square, title 'CalHacks 2025', two grey meta bars, a big orange JetBrains Mono countdown '06D 14H 22M 09S', and a dashed open-slot chip reading '1 TEAMMATE NEEDED' in mono; overlap a second plain grey card behind it to suggest a stack.
Section 'HOW IT WORKS' as a mono caps header, then three stacked hairline cards, each with a big JetBrains Mono number: 01 'Verify with your college email' with muted text 'We check your campus domain so everyone here is a real student.'; 02 'Tag your skills and availability' with muted text 'Tell the algorithm what you build and when you are free.'; 03 'Match with teams and start hacking' with muted text 'Send a request, get accepted, hand off to Discord.'
Section 'VERIFIED CAMPUS LEAGUE' as a mono caps header, then a wrapping centered row of six outlined mono chips: IIIT HYDERABAD, IIT BOMBAY, BITS PILANI, NIT TRICHY, VIT VELLORE, IIIT DELHI.
Footer: hairline top border, two short columns of mono links (PRODUCT: Hackathons, Teammates, Squads / COMPANY: About, Careers, Privacy), and a final mono line '© 2026 HACKMATCH — BUILT FOR CAMPUS SQUADS'.

HackMatch — College Hackathon Team Finder. MOBILE artboard, 390px logical width (design at 2x), one tall page containing two stacked frames. Apply the 'Tactile Editorial Minimalist' design system: warm off-white canvas #F9F9F8, white bento cards, 1px hairline borders #E4E4E0, ink #141413, muted ink #686763, International Orange #FF4F00 primary CTAs, Electric Cobalt #2563EB for the verified/active accent. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for ALL labels, codes and timers. Borders over shadows. No gradients.

FRAME A — sign in. A small mono caps token '@' inside a square, then the app name 'HackMatch' and a mono caps eyebrow 'ACCESS'. A headline 'Sign in to HackMatch' and a muted sub-line 'Use your college email.'. Then two labelled full-width hairline inputs: 'COLLEGE EMAIL' with placeholder 'maya@berkeley.edu', and 'PASSWORD' with placeholder '••••••••' and a tiny muted mono hint 'MIN 8 CHARACTERS'. A row with a hairline checkbox 'Remember me' on the left and an orange text link 'Forgot password?' on the right. A full-width solid orange button 'Sign in'. A hairline divider with centered mono 'OR'. A full-width bordered button 'No account? Create one'. A centered muted mono line 'ONLY VERIFIED CAMPUS DOMAINS CAN REGISTER.'
FRAME B — the OTP verification modal. Dim the whole artboard with a dark translucent scrim, and float a centered white card above it containing: a mono caps label 'VERIFICATION'; the title 'Verify your email'; the muted line 'We sent a 6-digit code to maya@berkeley.edu.'; a row of 6 individual square hairline-bordered digit cells, each holding one large JetBrains Mono digit — the first four filled ('4','7','9','2') and the last two empty with the next cell showing an orange focus border; a centered muted mono line 'CODE EXPIRES IN 09:41 · RESEND'; a full-width solid orange button 'Verify'; and a centered ghost text button 'Use a different email'.
Both frames must read as the same product in the same paper-and-ink style.
